toAgent.name: Send to agent
toAgent.menu: Ask the agent about this error
toAgent.fixDesc: Opens a new run with the error, ready to start
toAgent.explainDesc: The agent explains it in plain language and changes nothing
toAgent.nothing: There is no error to send
toAgent.nothingBody: Select the lines you want to send, or wait until something fails.
toAgent.noDialog: The New Run dialog could not be opened.
toAgent.failed: The error could not be prepared
toAgent.cmd.terminalFix: Fix the terminal error with agent
toAgent.section.name: Send to agent
toAgent.section.title: Fix with agent
toAgent.section.desc: A button next to terminal output, dev server logs, failed scripts and checks and preview errors that opens a new run with the error. Secrets are masked and only the last 8 KB is sent; nothing runs until you press Start run.
toAgent.section.enable: Show the Fix with agent buttons
toAgent.section.enableDesc: Also adds the terminal commands to the palette.
toAgent.reducedMask: The app's secret masker could not run, so a simpler one masked this text. Read it for passwords, tokens and keys before you start the run.
